director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket ground jaise shapes ka perimeter, yani boundary length, dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Achha, Riya. Cricket pasand hai toh socho: ground ke chaaron taraf fence lagani ho—humein sirf andar ka area chahiye ya poori boundary? Golu ko baad mein sikhaogi.
Boundary ki total lambai perimeter hoti hai. Rectangle mein 50 metre aur 30 metre, dono do-do baar jodte hain—tum total batao.
Riya, 4 sirf sides ki ginti hai, lambai nahi. Ek round perimeter hai: 50 plus 30, that is 80, times 2. Ab total?
Theek hai Riya—ab 160 ko teen baar jodo: 160 plus 160 plus 160 kitne metre honge?
Riya, tumne 160 ko 3 se multiply karne ke bajay 3 plus 3 kiya. Ab 160 ko teen baar jodne ka step socho. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Example: 4 cricket bats, har ek 20 rupees ka ho, toh total 20 ko 4 baar jodna. Ab 3 × 160 ka try karo.
Ab perimeter ke triangle wale example par dhyaan do. Sides ki lengths ko boundary ke liye jodna hai. Ek triangle ki sides 5 cm, 6 cm aur 9 cm hain. Iska perimeter kya hai?

director.text: Riya, perimeter ke liye triangle ki teeno sides jodni hoti hain: 5 plus 6 plus 9. Ab in teen numbers ko jodkar batao.
